readings: For each piece of equipment (`scanenvironment.equipref`), average its relative humidity (`humepct`), ignoring missing readings. Keep only equipment whose average is above the average of all equipment averages. For these, show the equipment reference, its average humidity, how much that exceeds the all-equipment average, and how far it is from the mean humidity of just the kept equipment. Return nothing if either reference average is missing. Sort by that last difference from highest to lowest with missing values last, and return exactly 10 rows, dropping any extra rows tied at 10th place arbitrarily. Use the absolute distance between each kept equipment average and the kept-equipment mean.

For each piece of equipment (`scanenvironment.equipref`), average its relative humidity (`humepct`), ignoring missing readings. Keep only equipment whose average is above the average of all equipment averages. For these, show the equipment reference, its average humidity, how much that exceeds the all-equipment average, and how far it is from the mean humidity of just the kept equipment. Return nothing if either reference average is missing. Sort by that last difference from highest to lowest with missing values last, and return exactly 10 rows, dropping any extra rows tied at 10th place arbitrarily. Use each kept equipment average minus the kept-equipment mean.
queries:
WITH equipment_averages AS (
    SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_humidity
    FROM scanenvironment
    GROUP BY equipref
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS avg_humidity
    FROM equipment_averages
),
kept_equipment AS (
    SELECT e.equipref, e.avg_humidity, o.avg_humidity AS overall_humidity
    FROM equipment_averages AS e
    CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o
    WHERE e.avg_humidity > o.avg_humidity
),
kept_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS avg_humidity
    FROM kept_equipment
)
SELECT
    k.equipref,
    k.avg_humidity,
    k.avg_humidity - k.overall_humidity AS excess_humidity,
    ABS(k.avg_humidity - a.avg_humidity) AS distance_from_kept_mean
FROM kept_equipment AS k
CROSS JOIN kept_average AS a
WHERE k.overall_humidity IS NOT NULL
  AND a.avg_humidity IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY distance_from_kept_mean DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

WITH equipment_averages AS (
    SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_humidity
    FROM scanenvironment
    GROUP BY equipref
),
all_equipment AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS overall_avg
    FROM equipment_averages
),
kept AS (
    SELECT e.equipref, e.avg_humidity, a.overall_avg
    FROM equipment_averages AS e
    CROSS JOIN all_equipment AS a
    WHERE e.avg_humidity > a.overall_avg
),
kept_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS mean_humidity
    FROM kept
)
SELECT
    k.equipref,
    k.avg_humidity,
    k.avg_humidity - k.overall_avg AS above_overall_avg,
    k.avg_humidity - m.mean_humidity AS difference_from_kept_mean
FROM kept AS k
CROSS JOIN kept_mean AS m
WHERE k.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
  AND m.mean_humidity IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY difference_from_kept_mean DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10
